name: pcb-adonisjs-bodyparser-protopollution
description: Real-library-wrap for @adonisjs/bodyparser FormFields prototype pollution (CVE-2026-25754 -> CVE-2026-48795). Three published npm versions installed side-by-side via npm aliases; the service runs the REAL BodyParserMiddleware.handle over a real multipart HTTP request and observes Object.prototype pollution in a fresh forked worker per probe.
